title: Targeted Insertional Mutagenesis using CRISPR/Cas9 in Chlamydomonas reinhardtii
author: Tyler Picariello
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdcki2uw

steps.title: Design and Prepare Donor DNA
steps.instruction: Design and amplify the antibiotic-resistance cassette with specific homology arms for the gene of interest.

substeps.instruction: Target an exon in the first 2/3 of the gene of interest to increase null mutation probability.
Use IDT or CRISPR direct websites for gRNA design.
Design a first set of PCR primers to amplify the antibiotic-resistance cassette from plasmid DNA.
Design a second set of primers to add homology arms specific for the gene of interest, positioned upstream and downstream of the SpCas9 cut site.
Gel purify the PCR products and elute in water.

steps.title: Prepare Chlamydomonas Cells
steps.instruction: Grow and treat cells to remove cell walls.

substeps.instruction: Grow cells synchronously on TAP + 1.5% agar plates (14:10 light:dark cycle) until confluent (typically 3-5 days).
Transfer cells to 6 mL of gametic autolysin solution; shake gently for 1.0 h at room temperature.
Verify cell-wall removal by mixing ~10 µL of cells with an equal volume of 0.5% Triton-X100 and observing lysis under a phase microscope (16x-objective lens). Repeat autolysin treatment if necessary.
Incubate cells (still in autolysin solution) at 40°C for 30 minutes with gentle agitation.

steps.title: Assemble gRNA and RNP Complex
steps.instruction: Generate the gRNA and the ribonucleoprotein (RNP) complex while cells are incubating in autolysin.

substeps.instruction: Assemble gRNA: Mix 10 µL of 40 µM tracrRNA in IDT RNA duplex buffer with 10 µL of 40 µM crRNA in RNA duplex buffer; heat for 2 min at 95°C and slow cool to room temperature.
Form RNP: Incubate 2 µL of gRNA complex with 5 µg of IDT Alt-R® S.p.Cas9 Nuclease V3 (10 µg/µL) in RNA duplex buffer (total volume 10 µL) for 15 min at 37°C.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Electroporation
steps.instruction: Wash and concentrate the autolysin-treated cells.

substeps.instruction: Wash cells in TAP + 2% sucrose and centrifuge at 1819 x g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cells in TAP + 2% sucrose (usually 500 µL to 1 mL) to a concentration of 2.0-7.0x10^8 cells/mL.

steps.title: Electroporation
steps.instruction: Perform electroporation of the RNP and donor DNA into the cells.

substeps.instruction: Mix approximately 110 µL of cell suspension, 10 µL RNP mix, and 2 µg donor DNA to a final volume of 125 µL.
Transfer mixture to a Bio-Rad 0.2-cm gap electroporation cuvette.
Electroporate at 350 V, 25 Ω, and 600 µF.
Immediately cool the cuvette in a 16°C water bath for 1 h.

steps.title: Post-Electroporation Recovery
steps.instruction: Allow cells to recover before plating.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cells to 10 mL of TAP + 2% sucrose (total volume).
Incubate for 24 h at room temperature with gentle rocking under dim light.

steps.title: Selection and Growth
steps.instruction: Plate cells on selection media and grow colonies.

substeps.instruction: Collect cells by centrifugation at 1819 x g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cell pellet in 3.5 mL of TAP + 0.5% agar (< 42°C).
Pipette onto TAP + 1.5% agar plates containing 10 µg/mL of paromomycin or hygromycin.
Grow plates with a 14:10 light:dark cycle at 23°C for approximately 1 week until colonies appear.

steps.title: Screening and Validation
steps.instruction: Isolate colonies and screen for mutations.

substeps.instruction: Transfer individual colonies to 150 µL M medium in 96-well plates; grow for 2-3 days (14:10 light:dark cycle).
Perform initial screening via PCR using primers designed to flank the SpCas9 cut site.

steps.title: Glass Bead Treatment (Optional/Alternative)
steps.instruction: Perform mechanical agitation using glass beads if required by specific variant of protocol.

substeps.instruction: Transfer mixture to a 15-mL tube with 0.3 g of glass beads (0.45-0.52 mm diameter) without adding PEG.
Vortex at top speed on a Vortex Genie 2 for 15 seconds, rest for 10 seconds, and vortex again for 10 seconds.
